verdict.rationale: The only evidence of event-triggered rules is AWS Budgets. Users can set budget thresholds on actual or forecasted spend and take action, such as automatically applying a custom IAM policy that denies further provisioning. That is a real rule-to-action mechanism, but it is limited to cost events. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event rules engine (e.g. event-pattern routing to arbitrary targets), evidence of event triggers for compute like Lambda, documentation of rule definition depth, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
